title: Run of the borrow operation
statement: Let $B$ and $F$ be finite Boolean Turing machines, let $a$ be a state of $B$, choose find mode, and let $x$ be an input word. For any base host configuration, input-head position, and Boolean word $w$, and for every prefix word $v$, start in control phase 8 with the counter tape storing the concatenation $vw$, its head at position $|v|$, and the other designated tapes blank. After $b(w)+1$ steps, the counter tape stores $v$ followed by the debited word obtained from $w$; its head is at $|v|+b(w)-1$, and the control phase is 9 if the debit reports a carry and 10 otherwise. The remaining designated frame data are preserved as specified.
